difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.9.2 at source lines 1390-1392: if H is essentially surjective and full then precomposition with H is fully faithful. The author's proof (source lines 1393-1439) is a long argument that avoids the axiom of choice by characterising the value to be defined: it exhibits a type of candidates with compatibility data (lines 1397-1399), proves it contractible in two stages, first inhabitation using essential surjectivity and fullness (lines 1401-1413) and then propositionality (lines 1414-1418), defines the natural transformation by the unique candidate (lines 1420-1421), verifies naturality by lifting a morphism along fullness (lines 1422-1437), and closes by checking that the composite with H is the original transformation (lines 1438-1439). Both hypotheses of the statement are used twice and in different ways, which the statement does not record.
